summary: Completed frontend-only verification for hero transition and timeline arrow-only behavior on public preview URL. Hero animation requirements pass; timeline wheel lock and arrow controls pass; menu navigation to Timeline/Cars remains broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Timeline and Cars menu links do not scroll to their targets reliably; targets remain far off-screen after click.

integration_issues.issue: Lenis-based section navigation is inconsistent: Legacy works (top≈0), but Timeline and Cars frequently land with large positive offsets (e.g., 1531/3691/5232 px desktop; 3290 px mobile).

action_items: Fix menu scroll targeting for Timeline/Cars in Nav.go so all links are deterministic with Lenis.
Retest all menu destinations (Hero/Legacy/Timeline/Cars at minimum) on desktop and mobile after Lenis navigation fix.
Keep current timeline behavior unchanged: wheel/page scroll must not change years; only arrows/keyboard should change year.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav target selection plus Lenis scroll integration is non-deterministic for specific sections and needs a single reliable scroll path for all menu links.
Large compressed CSS files reduce maintainability and make regression debugging harder for animation-heavy sections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS on requested hero/timeline features: hero stats 105/7/104 and trophy image alt correct; hero-sequence-v4 height resolved to 2160px with sticky viewport; scene scales down smoothly (transform approx 1 -> 0.70 -> 0.39 across scroll samples), LEWIS/HAMILTON move from opposite sides, Chapter 01 text + progress rail visible, Legacy reachable and visible, timeline runway height equals viewport (800px desktop), wheel does not change year (stays 2007), next/prev and keyboard arrows change exactly one year, active image updates with year, timeline can scroll through to Cars, no horizontal overflow on 1920x800 and 390x844. Remaining blocker: menu navigation fails for Timeline/Cars offsets.
rca of the issue: Repro: open menu, click Timeline/Cars (desktop and mobile). Observed target top remains far from viewport top after wait (e.g., timeline 3691, cars 5232). Legacy often lands at 0. Root cause likely Lenis scrollTo + section target/offset handling mismatch in Nav.go with dynamic/sticky layouts, producing non-deterministic final positions for deeper sections. Mitigation: route all menu jumps through one deterministic Lenis call with explicit offset and completion checks per target.
